description: One Hyperliquid wallet's CLOSED round-trip trades, newest close first, keyset-paged: per trade the symbol, direction, `open_ts` / `close_ts`, entry and exit price, the largest size held (`max_size_usd`), traded `volume_usd`, `realized_pnl` and `total_fee` in USD and the fill count. A trade still open is not listed. For statistics over these trades use hl_wallet view=trades_summary; for the raw fills hl_wallet_activity view=fills. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/wallets/{address}/trades.

address.description: Hyperliquid wallet address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. Bounds the close time.

limit.description: Trades per page, newest close first. Max 5000.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Bounds the close time.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. Omit for all symbols.

name: hl_wallet_trades
title: Hyperliquid Wallet Trades
